gloss: various places around the world; all over the world

definitions.gloss: various places around the world; all over the world
definitions.explanation: Many different locations throughout the world, emphasizing geographical spread.

examples.japanese: {世界各地|せかいかくち}から{観光客|かんこうきゃく}が{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Tourists visit from all over the world.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{世界各地|せかいかくち}で{起|お}きている。
examples.english: This problem is occurring in various places around the world.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世界各地|せかいかくち}を{旅|たび}して{回|まわ}り、それぞれの{土地|とち}の{文化|ぶんか}や{食|しょく}に{触|ふ}れてきた。
examples.english: He has traveled all over the world, experiencing the culture and food of each place.

notes:
A compound of {世界|せかい} (world) and {各地|かくち} (various places). Very common in news reporting and formal writing. Emphasizes that something is happening broadly across many locations, not just one or two.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}で: in various parts of the world
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}から: from all over the world
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}に: to various places around the world
- {世界各地|せかいかくち}を{旅|たび}する: to travel around the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世界中|せかいじゅう}: all over the world — emphasizes totality (everywhere) rather than diversity of locations
- {各国|かっこく}: various countries — focuses on national units rather than geographical places
- {世界各国|せかいかっこく}: countries around the world
